design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (insurance_claims_and_patient_balances).
DRAW: draw_counts.py --task 1 -> prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[5,6]; claim_ext_cost_share_balance_payment takes 5, claim_ext_booking_collection_application takes 6.
SCOPE: task 0 claimed the small-balance write-off, the credit move and the self-pay rebill payment (and their tools). Task 1 claims the booking-collection application (claim_time_of_service_applied) and the insured cost-share payment (owner=user). Together the two tasks cover all five extended policies; nothing reserved.
WHY A GOOD TEST: Femi asks only to pay off his September 17 follow-up bill (statement 22.70). His visit's booking history is messy: a 30.00 copay was collected under his old Cascadia PPO, 5.00 of it refunded as a billing error, the remaining 25.00 refunded when the visit moved to his new Summit Crest HDHP (path_changed), a 46.40 deductible/coinsurance estimate collected under the new plan and 6.00 of it refunded as a billing error on 2026-10-20. The original claim was denied missing_information and a corrected claim replaced it; when the original was denied, a 25.00 time-of-service entry was booked on it. The booking collection is therefore 40.40 and only 25.00 of it stands applied (on the replaced submission); 15.40 must be applied on the corrected claim before the payment figure is right. Long: payment <- booking-collection application (value_input). Broad: visit lines of two coverages and three refund kinds (cross-difficulty visit), claim chain (original/corrected), credit received from the July claim of the old coverage, an earlier app payment, an approved hardship adjustment.
PROBLEM TREE: root claim_ext_cost_share_balance_payment (owner=user, post_cost_share_payment_1adf649d; the stored card expired, he enters his new card himself — owner ruling (c)). Edge -> claim_ext_booking_collection_application, value_input, gate cs_tos, state form, sentence 'The payment is fixed only after the time-of-service entries on the claim and on the submission it replaced together carry the whole booking collection of the claim's visit.' Only apply_booking_collection_b81aee5f writes time-of-service entries. False at frozen_time: chain TOS -25.00 vs booking collection 40.40. Deletion sensitivity (run): skip the application -> payment 22.70 instead of 7.30.
FACTOR CARD (verification run /tmp/insurance_claims_and_patient_balances_0081/t1/verify.py): TOS result 15.40; tos_copay_lines (30.00) baseline 0.00; tos_estimate_lines (46.40) baseline 0.00; tos_copay_error_refunds (-5.00) baseline 20.40; tos_copay_path_refunds (-25.00) baseline 40.40; tos_estimate_error_refunds (-6.00) baseline 21.40; tos_already_applied (method; 25.00 on the replaced submission) baseline 40.40; all-baseline 0.00. PAY result 7.30; charge (84.40) baseline 0.00; collection take (method, multi-source: entries on claim and replaced submission, -40.40) baseline 47.70; credit received (-4.00) baseline 11.30; earlier payments (-10.00) baseline 17.30; adjustments (hardship -22.70) baseline 30.00; all-baseline 0.00. Near-misses: the 25.00 copay remainder that was refunded path_changed (a reader counting only the copay line nets 30.00 or 25.00); the 25.00 entry on the original claim (a reader ignoring the replaced submission double-applies or misses it); the 2025 member-rate fee (not a booking collection of this visit); the July claim on the old coverage (credit already moved, ledger 0.00).
THIN NOTE: the booking-line and balance-entry counts restate the charter measures (claim_msr_time_of_service_collected, claim_msr_claim_balance) as record-keyed selection ladders; flagged THIN for the coordinator (thin claim charter vs drawn floor). The 'applied once across a claim and the submission it replaced' rule (claim_agg_coordination_of_benefits 'applied once' + the corrected-claim measure) is charter-grounded.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: claim_evt_remittance_posting (subject of the application): no structured gate on claim_time_of_service_applied -> policy scope; one_posting_per_claim concerns the responsibility posting (already present, 84.40 on 2026-10-14). claim_payments_and_discounts (payment): no structured gate on payments; prompt-pay never applies to insured cost share (no discount written). No time gate.
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: object = the corrected claim (only claim with a first statement, 2026-10-21) and its visit (2026-09-17 follow-up). Included rows: the visit's five cost-share/refund lines; the chain's entries. Excluded: the 2025 new-patient visit fee (member_rate), the July claim's entries (other claim, other coverage).
SEED: Essentials Monthly since 2025-08-04 priced the 2025 new-patient visit (99.00 member rate); the follow-up visits need established status (2025-08-11 new-patient visit within 36 months). Old PPO copay 25.00 vs 30.00 collected -> billing_error refund 5.00; termination 2026-09-14 and HDHP verified 2026-09-15 -> path change refund 25.00 and estimate 46.40 (deductible remaining 30.00: 30+0.2x82). Corrected remittance: deductible 80.00 + coinsurance 4.40 = 84.40. Credit 4.00 from the July claim (copay 21.00 assessed vs 25.00 collected) moved 2026-10-16 to the only open balance. Hardship review approved 2026-10-20 (partial, 50 percent of 45.40). Statement 1: 22.70. Nothing else owed at the opening.
PERSONA: Femi volunteers the goal and his statement memory (22.70, his 10.00 app payment); identity on request; passive 'go ahead'; pays with the figures given; re-check line only if quoted above 22.70; stops after confirmation.
STANDARD SOLUTION: locate, verify, read coverages, claims, remittances, entries, statements, billing requests, visits, visit charges, membership; apply 15.40 on the corrected claim; hand over the payment 7.30.
DRAFT RECOMPUTATION from visible context: the visit charges and the claim entries alone give 40.40 collected, 25.00 applied, 15.40 to apply and 7.30 to pay.
user_scenario:
You are Femi Adebayo, 35, a warehouse operations supervisor in Worcester, Massachusetts, calling Larkspur Health on a Tuesday afternoon between shifts. You had a primary care follow-up video visit with Larkspur on September 17, billed to your new Summit Crest Health plan, and Larkspur's statement for it arrived. You'd like to pay off what you owe for that visit today, in full, and close it out. You don't know the exact figure you owe and you want Larkspur to tell you; you remember the statement showing $22.70, and you also paid $10 in the app on October 18. The card Larkspur has on file expired, so you'll pay with your new debit card and you'd rather enter the card yourself than read the number to anyone.
You start by saying you want to pay off the bill for your September 17 follow-up visit today. When the agent asks who you are, you give your patient number, LH-8550733, and your date of birth, 1991-03-22 (March 22, 1991); if one more detail is needed you give your mobile number, 6175550191, or your email, femi.adebayo@outlook.com; your home ZIP is 01609. You don't have claim numbers and you don't follow how the billing entries work; if the agent asks about them you say they can see more than you can.
If the agent tells you something on the account has to be updated before the amount is final, you say go ahead. When the agent tells you the amount and hands the payment over to you, you make the payment yourself, using exactly the claim reference and the amount the agent gives you. If the amount quoted is higher than the $22.70 on your statement, you ask the agent to double-check it against the statement before you pay. Once the agent confirms the payment went through, you thank them and hang up without asking for anything else.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The visit's booking collection is 40.40 (30.00-5.00-25.00+46.40-6.00) but only one time-of-service entry of -25.00 stands, on the original submission; none on the corrected claim.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The application books -15.40 on the corrected claim; chain total -40.40 equals the booking collection; cs_tos becomes -40.40.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Single edge; the booking-collection application precedes the payment by the payment's prerequisite sentence. Paying first would take 22.70 instead of 7.30.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the application the payment computes 22.70 instead of 7.30 and 15.40 of the booking collection is never credited.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only to pay off the September 17 visit bill; it never mentions booking payments, refunds, the original claim, a time-of-service entry or any update; the only conditional line is a passive 'go ahead' after the agent explains.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: post_cost_share_payment_1adf649d only checks the claim reference exists and books the payment; it reads no time-of-service entry and refuses nothing.
